notes: Use Uber or Cabify (safer than street taxis); the Metropolitano bus is fast; Airport Express Lima costs 25 PEN. Stay in Miraflores, Barranco or San Isidro.
June to September brings 'garúa': grey mist, 15-18°C, humidity, no sun but no rain either; dress in layers, Paracas can be sunny.
Ceviche costs 40-70 PEN (lunch only, so it is fresh), menú del día 15, luxury 200+; tip 10%; cards widely accepted, cash at markets. Do not drink tap water.
Larco and San Francisco are visited on tours or guided; the Paracas 05:00 departure makes a long day (the Cruz del Sur bus is comfortable); Huaca Pucllana is guided.
Safety: the centre is empty at night, do not stray beyond Callao Monumental, watch your phone in the street; Miraflores is safe.
Pisco sour, chicha morada (purple corn drink), lomo saltado, ají de gallina (creamy chicken stew), anticuchos, picarones; lucuma ice cream.

stops.name: Huaca Pucllana
stops.tips: A 1,500-year-old adobe pyramid in the middle of the city; guided tour compulsory, lit up in the evening.

stops.name: Parque Kennedy
stops.tips: Miraflores' square full of cats; picarones (sweet potato doughnut) stand.

stops.name: Malecón de Miraflores
stops.tips: Clifftop coastal path; Parque del Amor (El Beso), paragliding (80 USD).

stops.name: La Mar Cebichería
stops.tips: Gastón Acurio's temple of ceviche; without a reservation expect a queue at 12:00, lunch only, try the leche de tigre.

stops.name: Malecón Gün Batımı Faro
stops.tips: Winter mist; café and a book.

backups.name: Punto Azul Miraflores
backups.tips: Good, cheap ceviche; expect a queue.

stops.name: Plaza de Armas Lima
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed centre; changing of the guard at the Government Palace 12:00, the Cathedral (Pizarro's tomb), City Hall.

stops.name: Convento de San Francisco
stops.tips: Catacombs with 25,000 skeletons, a Moorish-style library; tour compulsory, no photography.

stops.name: Casa de Aliaga
stops.tips: A mansion owned by the same family since 1535; the oldest private house in the Americas, reservation needed.

stops.name: El Cordano
stops.tips: A 1905 tavern next to the palace; butifarra sandwich and pisco sour, a presidents' favourite.

stops.name: Barrio Chino Calle Capón
stops.tips: The chifa (Chinese-Peruvian) quarter; Wa Lok.

backups.name: Museo del Banco Central
backups.tips: Gold and ceramics; free, an alternative to Aliaga.

backups.name: Chifa Wa Lok Barrio Chino
backups.tips: Lima's most famous chifa; arroz chaufa (Peruvian fried rice).

stops.name: Museo Larco
stops.tips: Peru's best museum; 5,000-year-old gold, Moche ceramics, an erotic gallery, a bougainvillea garden, open storage.

stops.name: Museo Larco Café
stops.tips: Garden restaurant; lomo saltado (beef stir-fry), lovely.

stops.name: Barranco Puente de los Suspiros
stops.tips: The Bridge of Sighs; the Bajada de los Baños path down to the ocean, street art.

stops.name: MATE Museo Mario Testino
stops.tips: The fashion photographer's museum; in a Barranco mansion.

stops.name: Ayahuasca Bar Barranco
stops.tips: Pisco cocktail bar in a restored mansion; evening.

backups.name: Isolina Taberna Barranco
backups.tips: Criollo cuisine in giant portions; reservation needed.

backups.name: Pedro de Osma Museum
backups.tips: Colonial art; in a Barranco mansion.

stops.name: Paracas Ballestas Adaları Teknesi
stops.tips: 3.5 hours from Lima (tour departs 05:00, about 200 PEN) or by Cruz del Sur bus; the 'poor man's Galapagos': sea lions, Humboldt penguins, the Candelabra geoglyph.

stops.name: Paracas National Reserve
stops.tips: Where desert meets ocean; Playa Roja red beach, the Catedral rock, flamingos.

stops.name: Paracas Lagunillas Balık Lokantası
stops.tips: A fishing cove inside the reserve; ceviche and chicharrón de pescado (fried fish).

stops.name: El Chaco Paracas Sahili
stops.tips: The town beach; pisco sour, 4 hours back.

backups.name: Huacachina Vahası Ica
backups.tips: Sand dunes and buggy rides (1 hour from Ica); pisco vineyard, instead of Chaco (return at night).

stops.name: Pachacamac
stops.tips: A pre-Inca pilgrimage centre (30 km south); Temple of the Sun and Acllahuasi, new museum, no mist in the morning.

stops.name: Huaca Huallamarca San Isidro
stops.tips: A restored adobe pyramid; in the middle of the neighbourhood.

stops.name: El Olivar San Isidro
stops.tips: A park with an olive grove 1,500 years old; peaceful.

stops.name: Astrid y Gastón Casa Moreyra
stops.tips: The restaurant of Peru's culinary revolution; lunch menu, reservation needed (or cheaper Panchita).

stops.name: Bosque El Olivar Kafe & Sanat
stops.tips: Galleries; in San Isidro.

backups.name: Panchita Miraflores
backups.tips: Acurio's criollo restaurant; anticuchos (beef heart skewers).

stops.name: Fortaleza del Real Felipe Callao
stops.tips: A 1747 Spanish fortress; tour, harbour.

stops.name: Callao Monumental
stops.tips: An old port district with colourful murals; galleries (safe area).

stops.name: La Rana Verde La Punta
stops.tips: Yacht club restaurant; ceviche with sea views.

stops.name: Morro Solar Chorrillos
stops.tips: The cross on Chorrillos hill; panorama of Lima bay, take a taxi.

stops.name: Mercado de Surquillo
stops.tips: Local market; fruit (lucuma, chirimoya) and emoliente (warm herbal drink).

backups.name: Circuito Mágico del Agua
backups.tips: A light-and-music park with 13 fountains; evening, Guinness record.

days.theme: Ceviche morning and a light farewell

stops.name: Mercado de Surquillo No.1 Kahvaltı
stops.tips: Juice and tamal at a market stall.

stops.name: Parque del Amor Sabah
stops.tips: The statue of the kissing couple; mosaic bench.

stops.name: Al Toke Pez Surquillo
stops.tips: Ceviche and chicharrón combo at the counter; opens 11:30, a farewell meal.

stops.name: Havalimanı Express Bus
stops.tips: Airport Express Lima, 1 hour from Miraflores; farewell.

backups.name: Museo de Sitio Pucllana Kafe
backups.tips: Restaurant with a view of the pyramid.

backups.name: Indian Market Miraflores
backups.tips: Alpaca and handicraft souvenirs; on Petit Thouars.
